**\<\< Bio \>\>**  
Taichi Furuhashi is passionate about mapping, connecting local communities with maps and sharing knowledge to empower people. As you know, Huge Earthquake and Tsunami destroyed a lot of cities and local communities in East Japan area in 2011\. They are trying, how to make more resilient society with Mapping, Panorama/VR and Drone technology. Taichi is a professor of Aoyama Gakuin University and President of CrisisMappers Japan, NPO. Now he has started DRONEBIRD project with drones for Disaster Crisis Response. In the coronavirus pandemic starting in 2020, the Japanese government has begun focusing on Digital Transformation, with the government and local governments developing 3D spatial ID technology for building urban digital twins and operating drones in peacetime. He has served as chairperson and study committee member of these expert panels.
